newsitem.title: USA: BAB completes muffin stores agreement.
newsitem.headline: BAB completes muffin stores agreement.

text.p: BAB Holdings Inc said Friday it completed its merger agreement with New Jersey-based My Favorite Muffin Too Inc.
BAB will acquire the privately held operator and franchisor for 432,608 shares of BAB common stock, restricted until December 31, 1998, plus $260,000 in cash.
As previously announced, BAB said the acquisition will be immediately accretive to earnings. The company said it will increase its presence in key East Coast markets.
BAB also said it raised about $2 milion through an offering of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock.

BAB said it will retain the My Favorite Muffin's top management. In fiscal 1996, My Favorite Muffin had about $2.7 million in revenues. It has 65 muffin and bagel cafes, including five company-owned stores.
BAB operates the Big Apple Bagel chain and Brewster's Coffe retail coffee chain. Including My Favorite Muffin, BAB will have 237 units in 29 states and Canada, including 30 company-owned stores.
